Is D-Wave a Quantum Computer?

http://www.eetimes.com/document.asp?doc_id=1326592

The D-Wave computers are adiabatic quantum computers and work using a process called quantum annealing. They are machines that are very good at a specific kind of problem (finding global minima of functions). They aren't general purpose quantum computers that could, say, implement Shor's Algorithm and break most modern crypto.
